question_groups.question: Tell us about the passenger: what is their gender, loyalty status, age, and reason for travel?
question_groups.hint: e.g., Female, loyal customer, age 35, business travel

question_groups.question: What cabin class is the passenger flying, and how far is the flight in miles?
question_groups.hint: e.g., Business class, 1,500 miles

question_groups.question: How would the passenger rate the digital experience: in-flight Wi-Fi, ease of online booking, and online boarding (1-5 scale)?
question_groups.hint: e.g., Wi-Fi 3, booking ease 4, online boarding 4

question_groups.question: How would the passenger rate onboard comfort: seat comfort, legroom, cleanliness, and food quality (1-5 scale)?
question_groups.hint: e.g., seat comfort 4, legroom 3, cleanliness 4, food 3

question_groups.question: How would the passenger rate the in-flight entertainment, cabin crew service, and overall onboard service (1-5 scale)?
question_groups.hint: e.g., entertainment 4, inflight service 4, onboard service 3

question_groups.question: How does the passenger rate the ground experience: schedule convenience, gate location, baggage handling, and check-in (1-5 scale)?
question_groups.hint: e.g., time convenience 4, gate location 3, baggage 4, check-in 4

question_groups.question: Were there any delays? How many minutes was the departure delayed, and how many minutes was the arrival delayed?
question_groups.hint: e.g., 15 minutes departure delay, 10 minutes arrival delay

question_groups.question: What route and time period are you forecasting demand for?
question_groups.hint: e.g., JFK to LAX, March 2026

question_groups.question: What time period is this demand analysis for, and are you looking at a particular day of the week?
question_groups.hint: e.g., June 2026, focusing on Fridays

question_groups.question: What is the current capacity on this route: how many seats are available, what is the typical load factor, and how many weekly flights?
question_groups.hint: e.g., 180 seats per flight, 82% load factor, 14 weekly flights

question_groups.question: What are the typical passenger volumes and how far in advance do passengers book?
question_groups.hint: e.g., 25,000 passengers per month, average 21 days booking lead time

question_groups.question: What is the dominant market segment: which cabin class and what type of passengers (business vs leisure)?
question_groups.hint: e.g., Economy class, mostly leisure travelers

question_groups.question: How many competing carriers operate this route, and what is your approximate market share?
question_groups.hint: e.g., 4 competing carriers, 30% market share

question_groups.question: What is the equipment unit identifier, and what quality tier is it (Low, Medium, or High)?
question_groups.hint: e.g., unit 12345, Medium quality tier

question_groups.question: What are the current thermal readings: air temperature and process temperature (in Kelvin)?
question_groups.hint: e.g., air temp 300 K (about 27C), process temp 310 K (about 37C)

question_groups.question: What are the current mechanical readings: rotational speed (RPM) and applied torque (Newton-meters)?
question_groups.hint: e.g., 1500 RPM, 40 Nm torque

question_groups.question: How many minutes of tool wear have accumulated, and has any failure mode been observed?
question_groups.hint: e.g., 120 minutes of wear, no failure observed

question_groups.question: Which engine unit are you monitoring, and how many operational cycles has it completed?
question_groups.hint: e.g., engine 42, 150 cycles since overhaul

question_groups.question: What are the current operational settings for this engine (altitude, Mach number, throttle resolver angle)?
question_groups.hint: e.g., setting 1: -0.002, setting 2: 0.0003, setting 3: 100

question_groups.question: What are the core engine sensor readings: total temperature at LPC outlet, HPC outlet, and LPT outlet, plus total temperature at fan inlet?
question_groups.hint: e.g., sensor 2: 642, sensor 3: 1590, sensor 4: 1408, sensor 7: 554

question_groups.question: What are the pressure and ratio sensor readings: total pressure at HPC outlet, static pressure at HPC outlet, fuel/air ratio, and corrected speed?
question_groups.hint: e.g., sensor 8: 2388, sensor 11: 47.5, sensor 12: 521, sensor 13: 2388

question_groups.question: What are the flow-related sensor readings: physical core speed, corrected fan speed, bypass ratio, and bleed enthalpy?
question_groups.hint: e.g., sensor 9: 9065, sensor 14: 8139, sensor 15: 8.45, sensor 17: 393

question_groups.question: What are the auxiliary sensor readings: bleed pressure and high-pressure turbine coolant bleed?
question_groups.hint: e.g., sensor 20: 38.9, sensor 21: 23.3

question_groups.question: What airline are you analyzing? Provide the name, IATA code, ICAO code, and radio callsign.
question_groups.hint: e.g., Delta Air Lines, DL, DAL, DELTA

question_groups.question: In which country is the airline based or registered?
question_groups.hint: e.g., United States, United Kingdom, Germany

question_groups.question: Describe the airport: which city is it in, and what are its longitude, altitude (feet), and UTC timezone offset?
question_groups.hint: e.g., New York, longitude -73.78, altitude 13 ft, timezone -5

question_groups.question: What type of facility is this, and what daylight saving time convention does it follow?
question_groups.hint: e.g., large airport, European DST rules

question_groups.question: What route are you analyzing? Provide the origin airport, destination airport, and operating airline (IATA codes).
question_groups.hint: e.g., JFK to LHR operated by BA

question_groups.question: Is this a codeshare route, and what aircraft equipment is typically used?
question_groups.hint: e.g., yes codeshare, Boeing 737-800

question_groups.question: What aircraft are you analyzing? Provide the model designation, manufacturer, and engine type.
question_groups.hint: e.g., 737-800, Boeing, Jet engine

question_groups.question: Is this a multi-engine aircraft, and does it have turboprop modifications?
question_groups.hint: e.g., yes multi-engine, no TP mods

question_groups.question: What is the engine's thrust rating (lbs) and shaft horsepower?
question_groups.hint: e.g., 27,000 lbs thrust, 0 SHP for jets; 0 THR, 1,700 SHP for turboprops

question_groups.question: What are the aircraft dimensions: length, height, and wingspan (in feet)?
question_groups.hint: e.g., length 130 ft, height 41 ft, wingspan 118 ft

question_groups.question: What are the weight specifications: fuel weight capacity, manufacturer's empty weight, and all-up weight (in lbs)?
question_groups.hint: e.g., fuel 46,000 lbs, empty 91,000 lbs, all-up 174,000 lbs

question_groups.question: What are the key speed parameters: maximum speed and stall speed (in knots)?
question_groups.hint: e.g., Vmax 490 kts, Vstall 115 kts

question_groups.question: What are the altitude and climb specs: max ceiling (all engines), ceiling (one engine), rate of climb (all engines), and rate of climb (one engine) in feet/min?
question_groups.hint: e.g., ceiling 41,000 ft, one-engine ceiling 18,000 ft, ROC 2,500 ft/min

question_groups.question: What are the takeoff and landing parameters: liftoff speed, takeoff distance, landing speed, and landing distance?
question_groups.hint: e.g., liftoff at 130 kts over 5,000 ft, landing at 125 kts in 4,500 ft

question_groups.question: What is the aircraft range (nautical miles) and key efficiency ratios: power-to-weight, wing loading, and fuel fraction?
question_groups.hint: e.g., range 3,000 nm, power-to-weight 0.28, wing loading 125, fuel fraction 0.26

question_groups.question: What are the current weather conditions at the airport: wind direction (degrees), wind speed (knots), precipitation (inches), and altimeter setting?
question_groups.hint: e.g., wind from 270 degrees at 15 knots, 0.02 inches precipitation, altimeter 29.92

question_groups.question: Which airline and route are you pricing? Provide the carrier, origin city, and destination city.
question_groups.hint: e.g., Vistara from Delhi to Mumbai, or United from SFO to JFK

question_groups.question: What time of day does the flight depart and arrive?
question_groups.hint: e.g., morning departure, afternoon arrival

question_groups.question: How many stops does the flight make, what cabin class, and what is the total flight duration in hours?
question_groups.hint: e.g., nonstop, Economy class, 2.5 hours

question_groups.question: How many days before departure is the ticket being purchased?
question_groups.hint: e.g., 30 days before departure

question_groups.question: What is the origin airport, destination airport (IATA codes), and route distance in miles?
question_groups.hint: e.g., SFO to JFK, 2,586 miles

question_groups.question: How many fare coupons (segments) are in the itinerary, which quarter of the year, how many tickets, and is it within the contiguous US?
question_groups.hint: e.g., 2 coupons (one connection), Q3, 1 ticket, within contiguous US

question_groups.question: Which airline carrier is operating and marketing this fare?
question_groups.hint: e.g., AA (American Airlines), or DL (Delta)

question_groups.question: When did the incident occur? Provide the year, month, and day.
Who was the operator and what aircraft was involved? Provide the operator name, aircraft designation, type, make, and model.
question_groups.hint: e.g., United Airlines, Boeing 737-800, Airplane (A), Boeing, 737-824

question_groups.question: What are the aircraft specifications: mass class, number of engines, and engine type?
question_groups.hint: e.g., large mass class (4), 2 engines, turbo-fan (D)

question_groups.question: Where did the incident occur: which airport, state, and FAA region?
question_groups.hint: e.g., John F Kennedy Intl, NY, AEA (Eastern)

question_groups.question: What were the flight conditions: phase of flight, visibility, precipitation, and was a wildlife warning issued?
question_groups.hint: e.g., on approach, daytime visibility, no precipitation, no warning issued

question_groups.question: What were the flight parameters at the time of the incident: altitude (feet AGL), speed (knots), and distance from airport (miles)?
question_groups.hint: e.g., 500 feet AGL, 150 knots, 3 miles from airport

question_groups.question: What wildlife was involved: species name, quantity, and what impact did it have on the flight?
question_groups.hint: e.g., Canada goose, 2-10 birds, precautionary landing

question_groups.question: Which aircraft components were struck: radome, windshield, nose cone, and/or engine 1?
question_groups.hint: e.g., radome struck but no damage, windshield not struck

question_groups.question: For components that were struck, was there actual damage: radome damaged, windshield damaged, engine 1 damaged, and was wildlife ingested into the engine?
question_groups.hint: e.g., no radome damage, no windshield damage, engine 1 damaged, bird ingested

question_groups.question: Which safety metric are you analyzing, and for what year?
question_groups.hint: e.g., Fatal accidents, 2023
